summary: Nuo Therapeutics filed an 8-K on October 6, 2026 disclosing a Consent and Extension (Sept 30, 2026) and an Assignment, Joinder, and Amendment No. 1 (Oct 6, 2026) to its Amended and Restated Loan and Security Agreement dated May 29, 2026. The Second Funding of $325,000 closed October 6, 2026, bringing aggregate borrowings to $2,000,000. Second Notes bear 12% interest, mature December 31, 2028, with interest payable in warrants. Director Scott Pittman, a >10% holder, assumed $25,000; four assuming lenders took $100,000 in equal portions. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation.
